original-preserved: All original data is preserved in its entirety and unmodified during processing.
bounded-memory: The system operates within a memory limit of 1GB to ensure stability and prevent resource exhaustion.
event-time: Events are processed in the order they occur, maintaining temporal consistency.
explainable-transform: Every transformation applied to event data is documented and explained in a human-readable format.
The system will maintain a separate memory context for each work unit, ensuring isolation between different conversational threads.
The system will allow for barge-in behavior, where new interactions can be initiated without waiting for the previous one to complete.
Exports from the system will be fully editable, allowing for modification of both content and structure post-export.
No false progress will be reported; all progress indicators will reflect actual job completion events.
